_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% directional hit rate over 7 days and 0-of-42 windows with ±2+ point moves make HOLD the statistically honest default — the August bottom analog suggests accumulation is underway but there is no breaker signal yet to justify a directional bet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partially — both see a bottoming/accumulation setup, but the narrative's bullish framing conflicts with the analyst's explicit HOLD signal and 0.45 confidence; the analyst's higher trust weight and the base-rate coil statistics override the narrative's implied directionality
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth breaks above 50 AND fed_liquidity lifts off 0 with BTC funding staying tame under 0.003%
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with exchange_netflow staying at 100 AND btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d rolling over below 90, signaling distribution not accumulation
